description: The robot navigates to a target location while avoiding obstacles until the target is reached.

atomic_propositions.moving: True when linear_vel > 0.05. The robot is actively moving.
atomic_propositions.near_target: True when distance_to_target < 0.5. The robot is close to the target location.
atomic_propositions.obstacle_detected: True when min_range < 0.25. A close obstacle is detected.
atomic_propositions.nav_accepted_or_executing: True when nav_status in ['accepted', 'executing']. The navigation command is active.
atomic_propositions.nav_success: True when nav_status == 'succeeded'. The navigation task completed successfully.
atomic_propositions.nav_failure: True when nav_status in ['aborted', 'canceled']. The navigation task failed or was stopped.

execution_phases.description: The robot is executing the path plan and moving towards the target.
The robot is in the final stages of approach to the target.

terminal_success.description: The navigation status explicitly reports success.

terminal_failure.description: The navigation status reports cancellation or abortion.
